I am fitting a semi-continuous model to simulated catch data. The codes were packaged as a function. The codes were published and used to work. But today I ran into crashes, they occur immediately after calling inla, but there is no specific error messages.

Is there any change to the package that could cause this crash?

Thanks

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] crashes semi-continuous models
parts: On Sat, 2017-12-09 at 09:59 -0800, Dong Liang wrote:

> Dear Group,
>
> I am fitting a semi-continuous model to simulated catch data. The
> codes were packaged as a function. The codes were published and used
> to work. But today I ran into crashes, they occur immediately after
> calling inla, but there is no specific error messages.

The issues was caused by having factors with the same levels, and then
using the inla expand strategy. that function did not append the name
of the variable itself, and only used the factor levels, which cause
two effects with the same name, and that caused the error. this is
fixed now.

thx!
H
